summary: Comprehensive architectural and UX implementation plan covering all 14 reported issues: world-space cursor isolation during pan, smooth Bezier freehand pen strokes, visible eraser & pen cursors, reliable sonar ping tool, enhanced AI vector/SVG drawing engine, 2-column draggable vertical toolbar, 3-minute/50MB video validation & memory optimization, chat quick reaction positioning, universal instant file-to-canvas insertion, pointer-capture boundary protection, non-overflowing top navigation bar, true edge-to-edge fullscreen code editor, and direct interactive terminal input.
